newsitem.title: USA: Omega Cabinets Ltd sells $100 mln 144a notes.
newsitem.headline: Omega Cabinets Ltd sells $100 mln 144a notes.

text.p: The following 144a debt issue from Omega Cabinets Ltd was priced Friday via lead manager Goldman Sachs & Co, according to a market source.
Omega Cabinets, headquartered in Waterloo, Iowa is a manufacturer of wood and laminate kitchen cabinetry, bathroom vanities, and related accessories.
TYPE SNR SUB NOTES ISS PRICE 100.00 FIRST PAY DATE 12/1/1997 LAST MOODY'S B3 YIELD 10.50 PCT PAY FREQ SEMI-ANNUAL
LAST S&P B-MINUS SPREAD +427 BPS CALLABLE NON-CALL FIVE
NOTE: The notes have a three-year equity for 35 percent of the issue at 110.50. ((U.S. Corporate Bond Unit, 212-859-1678))
